name: get_ownership
label: Get ownership
description: Retrieves the ownership structure of a company. When individual owners are included the list can be bounded by a materiality threshold — always check owners_truncated before treating the owner list as complete.

parameters.help: Down = companies this company owns | Up = who owns this company (UBO) | Both = both.
parameters.name: direction
parameters.label: Direction

parameters.help: Accepted for backward compatibility and echoed back, but the response is identical for every value. Values are clamped to 1-10. Do not use this field to request indirect owners or holdings.
parameters.name: depth
parameters.label: Depth (accepted but IGNORED)

parameters.help: Include sensitive personal shareholders (UBO). This is a consent control, not a subscription tier. With a direct API key the KEY's own sensitive-ownership consent decides — not the account's; a consented key works even when the account flag is off, and the target orgnr must be within any allowlist on the API key. Without it the call is rejected with 403. Only applies when direction is up or both — direction=down returns holdings only and never contains persons.
parameters.name: include_persons
parameters.label: Include individual owners

interface.name: depth
interface.label: Depth echoed back (does not affect the result)

interface.name: owners
interface.label: Owners — TWO shapes. Read owners_source first: empty = the derived annual-register shape, 'brreg_rrh_official' = the official RRH shape.

spec.name: owner_orgnr
spec.label: DERIVED: organization number — business owners only

spec.name: owner_person_key
spec.label: DERIVED: stable person key — use with 'Get person shareholdings'

spec.name: birth_year
spec.label: DERIVED: birth year (masked) — person owners only

spec.name: statsborgerskap
spec.label: OFFICIAL RRH: citizenship; text, or an array of codes when the person holds several

spec.name: bostedsland
spec.label: OFFICIAL RRH: country of residence; text, or an array when several values are registered

spec.name: kontrollgrunnlag
spec.label: OFFICIAL RRH: basis of control — why this person is a beneficial owner; an array of codes from posisjoner[], or a single text value from registrertGrunnlag

spec.name: andel_intervall
spec.label: OFFICIAL RRH: share interval, when only a band is reported; always an array when present

interface.name: holdings
interface.label: Holdings — companies this company owns (down/both); null when none

interface.name: owners_count
interface.label: Number of owners returned 🚨 Computed from the DERIVED annual-register list, BEFORE the official RRH list replaces owners. When owners_source is 'brreg_rrh_official' this value describes a list that was discarded — do NOT read it as a statement about the owners you received.

interface.name: owners_truncated
interface.label: Owner list is TRUNCATED — the UBO picture is incomplete 🚨 Computed from the DERIVED annual-register list, BEFORE the official RRH list replaces owners. When owners_source is 'brreg_rrh_official' this value describes a list that was discarded — do NOT read it as a statement about the owners you received.

interface.name: owners_materiality_threshold_pct
interface.label: Materiality threshold applied (%) — owners below it are omitted 🚨 Computed from the DERIVED annual-register list, BEFORE the official RRH list replaces owners. When owners_source is 'brreg_rrh_official' this value describes a list that was discarded — do NOT read it as a statement about the owners you received.

interface.name: owners_note
interface.label: Backend note about the owner list 🚨 Computed from the DERIVED annual-register list, BEFORE the official RRH list replaces owners. When owners_source is 'brreg_rrh_official' this value describes a list that was discarded — do NOT read it as a statement about the owners you received.

interface.name: kilde
interface.label: Provenance of the owner list — derived from the annual shareholder register, or official RRH when the premium track served it

interface.name: owners_source
interface.label: The ONLY reliable provenance marker. 'brreg_rrh_official' = fresh official beneficial-owner lookup. Empty = either the derived annual list, or no owners branch ran at all (direction=down). 🚨 When set, IGNORE owners_count, owners_truncated, owners_materiality_threshold_pct and owners_note — they were computed from the discarded derived list.

interface.name: kilde_tidspunkt
interface.label: When the official RRH data was retrieved — official lookups only

interface.name: disclaimer
interface.label: 🚨 Freshness caveat on the DERIVED owner list. Present = the owners come from the annual shareholder register and may be stale. ABSENT proves nothing on its own — with direction=down the owners branch never runs, so neither this nor owners_source is set. Official RRH is indicated ONLY by owners_source == 'brreg_rrh_official'.
